intentions.title: Produce EDItEUR-spec-conformant ONIX 3.0 XML from book documents for Bokbasen wholesale ingestion
intentions.evidence: message.ex wraps Header + Product children into <ONIXMessage release="3.0"> with the reference-tag namespace per EDItEUR §3.0; descriptive_detail.ex, collateral_detail.ex, publishing_detail.ex, product_supply.ex each build one ONIX block; codelists.ex resolves 14 ONIX codelists (17,93,150,175,23,25,45,58,65,91,96,153,154,158,159) against the vendored XSD at priv/onix/onix-3.0/ONIX_BookProduct_CodeLists.xsd.

intentions.title: Never let structurally invalid ONIX leave the pipeline — XSD validation is a hard gate, not a lint
intentions.evidence: validator.ex runs `xmllint --noout --schema` against the vendored EDItEUR reference XSD (ONIX_BookProduct_3.0_reference.xsd); tests tagged `:validator` and CI installs libxml2-utils with 'no --exclude :validator on CI — the gate must run'; codelists.ex raises ArgumentError on unknown codes rather than silently emitting an invalid enum value.

intentions.title: Guarantee every export is byte-stable and reproducible across VM restarts for proof-artifact regeneration
intentions.evidence: message.ex explicitly uses an ordered keyword list (not a map) for ONIXMessage attrs, with a comment citing Goal barkpark-mgu surfacing map-enumeration nondeterminism as proof-artifact drift in `mix onix.export_proof` regens.

intentions.title: Synthesize Bokbasen-friendly defaults (Norwegian locale, sane placeholders) so incomplete book.json never blocks export
intentions.evidence: product_supply.ex synthesizes a default NO-territory ProductSupply with SupplierRole 09, ProductAvailability 20 (Available), UnpricedItemType 01 (Free of charge placeholder) when book.json carries no productSupplies; header.ex defaults dataset to "production" and SenderName to placeholder "barkpark.cloud" pending WI7 GLN identifier.

intentions.title: Give Bokbasen submission status a single consistent visual vocabulary across every Studio surface
intentions.evidence: status_pill.ex consolidates color_class/1 and label/1 into one module after two earlier call sites (removed BookEditor LV and BokbasenLive) each carried duplicate copies of the same 9-state → 5-bucket mapping; moduledoc frames this as 'Phase 8 WI5 consolidation... defined in exactly one place'.

intentions.title: Emit only XSD-legal element ordering and cardinality even where it costs extra branching
intentions.evidence: product_supply.ex moduledoc: AgentRole must precede AgentName ('XSD enforces that ordering'); MarketPublishingStatus is emitted as mandatory even under defaults; empty optional containers (e.g. empty <Price>) are never emitted because they 'fail XSD validation in WI5'.
